rule: Theorem application (first K law: full collapse at w iff every accessible world is w), identity substitution, negation introduction
meaning: Frame class K (no frame condition). By the verified K collapse law (MODAL-K-LAWS), full collapse at w on the route's frame holds exactly when every world accessible from w is w. The node gives an accessible world lacking its witness; under collapse that world is w, where the witness exists. So the route's world is not collapsed. Without the node collapse holds (one-world frame).
